acceptance: PROVISIONAL; RMS failed; full raster and browser verified with geographic limitations
limitations: Ten excluded checks give RMS 175.21 m, exceeding the 100 m ceiling. Median 81.76 m, P95 340.68 m and maximum 382.85 m also exceed suggested companion bounds; the failed first fit is retained unchanged.
Janvrin Point has a large fitting residual (390.04 projected m); all fitting diagnostics and independent check errors remain reported. This fit is not geographically accepted.

Western lake cohorts and paired endpoints on Birch, McNamara and McLeod islands are spatially correlated. Northern and far western edges, eastern inland lakes, engineered Port Tupper shores and parcel interiors lack sufficient validation.
Eastern O Seal peninsula has one control but no secure local independent island check. Source uncertainty is 18 px there and 12 px elsewhere.
